plain.li: Dreamt the whole herd came down off the hill at dusk, more of them than we've ever had, and I knew every one by name.
I dreamt I was lying in long grass in the middle of the herd, and they grazed around me as if I were one of them.
[winter] Dreamt it was spring and the pens were full of young ones, all legs, falling over each other.

warm.li: Dreamt I walked among the herd at night and every one of them was warm and well. I woke up smiling.

cheerful.li: I dreamt the herd could count, and they counted me in at the gate for a change!

cold.li: Dreamt of the herd at twice its size. I woke up working out the feed.

plain.li: In my dream the animals could talk, and they'd been talking about us all along. They weren't impressed.
Dreamt an old muffalo sat me down and explained, very slowly, everything I'd been doing wrong with the herd.
[child] I dreamt the animals had a council too, and the goat was in charge, and nobody could vote against the goat.

blunt.li: Dreamt the animals talked. Mostly complaints.

gloomy.li: The animals could talk in my dream. They asked why we keep them. I didn't have an answer.

cold.li: Dreamt the herd discussed its own management. Some of the points were valid.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of something at the pens

plain.li: Dreamt something was moving around the pens in the dark, and I couldn't find the lantern, and the herd was screaming.
In the dream the fence was down and the pens were empty, and there were tracks I didn't recognise leading away into the snow.
[afterraid] Dreamt the raiders came back for the animals. I could hear them and I couldn't move.

warm.li: I dreamt I couldn't get to the animals in time. I went out to the pens before breakfast just to count them.

blunt.li: Dreamt something got into the pens. Checked. Nothing did.

gloomy.li: Dreamt we lost the whole herd in one night. It felt like a warning.

cold.li: A dream about the pen's weak corner. I'll reinforce it today.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of an animal that's gone

plain.li: My old companion came back in my dream, young again, and ran ahead of me all the way to the river and waited for me there.
I dreamt I heard the old familiar scratching at the door, and opened it, and there was nothing but moonlight. I left it open.
[child] My animal came to visit me in my dream. It said it was fine where it is, and there are lots of sticks.

warm.li: Dreamt my old friend was curled at the foot of my bed, heavy and warm, like always. I woke up with my feet cold.

blunt.li: Dreamt about my animal. Good dream. Bad waking up.

gloomy.li: It was there in the dream, waiting by the gate. Then the gate was empty, and so was I.

cold.li: A dream about the animal I lost. I seem to be taking it harder than I let on.

plain.li: I dreamt I rode on the back of the biggest animal in the world, so high I could see over the walls and all the way to the sea.
Dreamt I had a horse that could run faster than the wind, and it was mine, and we went everywhere.
[winter] I dreamt I rode through the snow on a great shaggy animal, and I wasn't cold at all.

cheerful.li: I rode a thrumbo in my dream! It was soft and it smelled of hay and it let me hold its horn!

gloomy.li: Dreamt I was riding, and then I fell off and the animal kept going without me.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a young animal grown old

plain.li: Dreamt {PET_nameDef} was young again, all legs and noise, tearing round the yard like the day we met.
In the dream {PET_nameDef} and I walked all the way to the far hills without stopping, and neither of us was tired.

warm.li: {PET_nameDef} was a youngster again in my dream, and I got to have all those years over. I woke up grateful for them.

gloomy.li: Dreamt {PET_nameDef} was young. Then I woke up and heard the old slow breathing by the bed, and was glad of it anyway.

plain.li: Dreamt my Pokémon started to glow, brighter and brighter, and when the light faded it was something I'd never seen, and it still knew me.
I dreamt my Pokémon evolved three times in one night, and each time it turned round to check I was still watching.
[child] I dreamt my Pokémon got so big it could carry me to the moon. We went. It was nice.

warm.li: In my dream my Pokémon evolved, and the first thing it did was come and lean against me, the way it always does.

cheerful.li: My Pokémon evolved in my dream and learned a move that made flowers grow everywhere!

cold.li: A dream about evolution. I woke up with three new ideas for its training.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a legendary Pokémon

plain.li: Dreamt a great bird of ice flew over the colony so low its wings frosted the roofs, and it looked straight at me.
In the dream something huge moved under the earth, and every Pokémon in the colony turned to face the same way.
I dreamt of the old legends: a Pokémon made of lightning, standing on the ridge in a storm, waiting for someone worthy.

blunt.li: Dreamt of a legendary. Big. Watching. Gone at dawn.

gloomy.li: Something ancient was looking for me in the dream. I don't know if I want it to find me.

cold.li: A dream about a legendary Pokémon. The stories say they reward a full Pokédex. I'll look into it.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of an empty ball

plain.li: Dreamt I threw my ball to let my Pokémon out, and it opened empty, and kept opening empty however many times I threw it.
In the dream my Pokémon wouldn't come when I called. It just watched me from across the field like a stranger.
[afterraid] I dreamt my Pokémon fainted in the fight and I couldn't reach it through the smoke.

warm.li: Dreamt I lost my Pokémon. I went and sat with it for an hour after I woke, until my hands stopped shaking.

blunt.li: Bad dream. Empty ball. Checked. It's fine.

gloomy.li: My Pokémon had forgotten me in the dream. I'm afraid that one day it will.

cold.li: An anxious dream about my Pokémon. I'll spend more time with it today.
